# Captured DNF advisory format contracts

The DNF4 fixtures were captured from Rocky Linux 8/9/10 with DNF
4.7.0/4.14.0/4.20.0. The DNF5 5.2 fixtures came from Fedora 42 with DNF
5.2.18.0. The `5.3` fixtures name the 5.3-and-later schema family and were
captured from Fedora 44 with DNF 5.4.3.0.

Descriptions and unrelated build variants were shortened after capture. IDs,
severity spellings, wrapped CVE/reference shapes, timestamps, NEVRAs, and the
top-level JSON shapes remain representative of the C-locale command output.
